```yaml
name: Benchmark v2 Set

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      task_count:
        description: 'Number of tasks to run (1-10)'
        required: true
        default: '2'
        type: number

jobs:
  generate-tasks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Generate top reward tasks
        run: bun scripts/generate-v2-top-reward-tasks.ts

      - name: Commit generated tasks
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add data/v2-top-reward-tasks.json
          git commit -m "Update top reward tasks for benchmark v2"
          git push origin main

  benchmark:
    needs: generate-tasks
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.agent }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        agent: [ubuntu-latest]
        task_id: ${{fromJson(needs.generate-tasks.outputs.task_ids)}}
        max-parallel: 1

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: npm run benchmark -- --task-id ${{ matrix.task_id }}

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-results-${{ matrix.task_id }}
          path: results/${{ matrix.task_id }}.json
```

        description: 'Number of tasks to run (1-10)'
        required: true
        default: '2'
        type: number

jobs:
  generate-tasks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Commit generated tasks

          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add data/v2-top-reward-tasks.json
          git commit -m "Update top reward tasks for benchmark v2"
          git push origin main

  benchmark:
    needs: generate-tasks
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.agent }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        agent: [ubuntu-latest]
        task_id: ${{fromJson(needs.generate-tasks.outputs.task_ids)}}

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3

          node-version: '16'

        run: npm install

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: npm run benchmark -- --task-id ${{ matrix.task_id }}

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
